newsitem.title: JAPAN: Six markets prepared to cooperate on issues - U.S..
newsitem.headline: Six markets prepared to cooperate on issues - U.S..

text.p: Six Asian-Pacific economies are prepared to cooperate on a range of issues, including financial market regulations and capital flow management, U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers told reporters on Tuesday.

"Members at this meeting had indicated they are prepared to cooperate on the range of issues they discussed, which had to do with things ranging from financial market regulations to issues related to the management of capital flows and to issues related to international financial institution policies toward particular countries," he said.
Summers said he thought the meeting of finance and central bank officials from the United States, Japan, China, Hong Kong, Australia and Singapore was useful.
"I expect the group to meet again. The discussions were fruitful," he said.
